name: Clip Launch (column) Mode
convention: OMX-27: 27 RGB LED keys addressed by key index 0-26, exactly matching the firmware strip.setPixelColor(index, 0xRRGGBB). key 0 = AUX (top-left). keys 1-10 = the 10 black keys (top row). keys 11-26 = the 16 white keys (bottom row). Each led is a colour "#RRGGBB"; "#000000" means the LED is off. keyMap lists each key's musical note. Controls (5 pots, the encoder turn/press, and the 128x32 OLED screen) carry text notes per state. Multiple states are alternative pages/modes of the same hardware.

states.name: Clip Launch by column (column 5 selected)
states.notes: Same as Clip Launch, but black keys 3-10 select a Launchpad column (track 1-8, left to right) and keys 11-18 are that column's pads, key 11 = row 8 (top) .. 18 = row 1, matching the OLED grid. Keys 19-26 = row launch, key 19 = row 8. Keys 1/2 Clear/Duplicate, both held = mute chord. Encoder selects the column.

keyNotes.1: Clear (hold CC60) + tap a pad to delete. Keys 1+2 together = Mute chord: Launchpad Mute held, keys 3-10 mute/unmute tracks 1-8
keyNotes.2: Duplicate (hold CC50): source, destination. Keys 1+2 together = Mute chord
